collection.title: Mercedes-Benz C Class Saloon 2000 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz C Class Saloon 2000 to 2003 (C203) model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
